systems.system: Irembo (Police services: registration for driving tests, driving licence application, renewal and replacement, traffic fines, motor vehicle inspection)
systems.owner: Rwanda National Police is the institution for the services; back-office processing is each government institution's responsibility
systems.tiers: Online and by mobile phone, nationally; also through Irembo agents who apply on a citizen's behalf for a commission

note: No fact: the document names the police only as the institution behind Irembo's driving-licence, traffic-fine and vehicle-inspection services, and says nothing of how a station records a report or a case.
